entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • TickCount64's Fixed ~15ms Resolution Hurts .NET's Semi-Realtime Responsiveness Despite timeBeginPeriod(1) #122680
  • Devirtualize calls dominated by a type assertion #122679
  • UnsafeAccessor with generic struct segfault #122678
  • Why does DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics default to 1 ? #122674
  • Specific Continuation types for each method need to be encoded in the ready to run image. #122673

Closed

  • Is Task.IsFaulted without Exception possible? #122675
  • TryAddEnumerable and singleton #53327

Created

    area-System.Net.Http, 11.0.0

Merged

    Servicing-consider, 10.0.x
